response.text:
I can do that — a couple quick clarifications before I add it to your calendar:

1) Which Tuesday (date) should I book?  
2) Do you mean 4:00 PM your time (Chicago) or 4:00 PM her time (Singapore)? (If helpful: 4:00 PM Chicago = 5:00 AM Singapore next day; 4:00 PM Singapore = 3:00 AM Chicago.)  
3) Auditor’s email address (so I can add her as an attendee).  
4) Event title (I can use “Intro with external auditor” unless you prefer something else) and do you want a conferencing link (Google Meet/Zoom) or just the calendar entry?  
5) Add to your calendar in Chicago timezone (America/Chicago)?  

Tell me those and I’ll put the 30-minute event on the calendar.
